0022600197.text: The Detroit Pistons host the Los Angeles Lakers with Detroit at 6-2, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, though they come in on a one-game losing streak, while the Lakers are also 6-2, 1st in the Pacific and 4th in the West, riding a two-game winning streak. Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain), both listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Pistons won both games of the 2025-26 season series and their last meeting, 113-110 in Detroit on March 23, 2026.
